Agent Name: CorporateHistory_IPOs_MondayCom_Expert
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The agent made a factual error in Step 4 when manually extracting the C-suite members at the time of the IPO from the WSJ search results. The agent listed only Roy Mann, Eran Zinman, and Eliran Glazer as the C-suite members at the IPO date (June 10, 2021). However, historical records indicate that Oren Stern (CMO) was a prominent executive in the C-suite at the time of the IPO (he was named CMO in early 2021). By excluding Oren Stern from the "IPO C-suite" list, the agent incorrectly concluded that he did not hold a C-suite position during the IPO, leading to a false positive in the final list. The agent relied on an incomplete snippet or manual interpretation that missed key executives present at the IPO.
